summary: A Belgravia specialist with decades of experience is a strength, but dead valuation buttons and an unfinished contact route appear to cost you vendors.

findings.problem: Request an Appraisal, Register as a Buyer and Click Here under Free Market Appraisal appear to link to #, and Get in touch appears to link to # with no visible form.
findings.cost: A vendor who wants a valuation hits a dead button.

findings.problem: The tagline 'Our team of experts are here to help you...' appears to end with an ellipsis, and INDEPENDENT PROPERTY CONSULTANTS appears three times.
findings.cost: Unfinished and repeated copy look careless.
findings.fix: Finished copy and one clear message.

findings.problem: A quote appears to read 'The first men to come to if you want to move to Belgravia' and a testimonial appears with no named author.
findings.cost: Garbled quotes and unnamed proof weaken trust.

findings.problem: The page appears to say 'almost 60 years' and 'over 60 years', Sold and Let Properties appear to link to ?Itemid=214 and ?Itemid=215, and the footer address appears to be in Fulham.
findings.cost: Conflicting claims and unreadable links confuse buyers and vendors.
findings.fix: One verified claim and readable links.

redesign: Working valuation, registration and contact forms.
One verified claim and readable URLs.
